snippet.title: PV - GAME The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!
snippet.description:
A fast-paced arena shooter game with simple controls and strategic battles.
Experience a story original to the game, starring the characters of Appraiser (Provisional).

■ Game Overview
Title: GAME The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!~Dungeon and Mystery Girl~

Platforms: Nintendo Switch / PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®4 / Steam®

Release Date: Thursday, April 23, 2026

Price: $23.99 (tax included) Download only

Genre: Action / Casual

IARC Rating: 7+

Official Website: https://sunsoft.games/kanteishikari-game/top

PSStore：https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/concept/10018248
Nintendo eSHOP：https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000117262
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4320940/

■ What is "The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!"
“The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!” (Original story: Atekichi / Illustration: Shigaraki Asahi / Manga: Takeshi Takeda, published by Alphapolis) is a novel-based series that has surpassed 1 million copies in total circulation.
